F-001.description: Integration audit: working draft summary permits empty text, submit originally accepted it, but immutable submittedRevisionSchema requires nonempty summary. This could commit a revision that Reviewer detail cannot parse. Reject blank/whitespace summary at submit before writes; preserve drafts, and independently verify422/full rollback regression plus valid submission.

F-002.description: Independent review F-002: disabling a Reviewer on completed APPROVED leaves ACTIVE assignment intentionally. Owner reopen originally retained that disabled assignee into CHANGES_REQUESTED, after which retained() rejects submit/withdraw forever. Reopen must lock both account IDs before session/root, recheck pointers and atomically release now-unfinished unavailable assignment with preserved history and correct queue.

F-003.description: Independent review F-003: session touch computes expiresAt predicate before waiting on a row lock, so it can renew an expired session after acquiring the lock. Touch must explicitly lock persisted session row, then check current idle/absolute expiry before update, never resurrect missing/expired row; session-only lock ordering. Barrier test touch begins live, waits past expiry, then rejects renewal.
